overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、行为金融（1 篇）、保险与养老（1 篇）。方法上以机器学习、回归分析为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、NBER（3 篇）、OpenAlex（2 篇）。其中 3 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Dinâmica da Indústria Têxtil no Maranhão: estruturas de mercado e competitividade (1880-1940)
papers.abstract: Este artigo investiga a trajetória da indústria têxtil no Maranhão entre 1880 e 1940, explorando suas fases de implementação, expansão e declínio. Fundamentado nas teorias de estruturas de mercado de Paolo Sylos Labini e Joan Robinson, o estudo analisa como a concentração oligopolista, a gestão familiar e a defasagem tecnológica influenciaram a competitividade regional. A abordagem metodológica integra análise histórica e microeconômica, utilizando dados sobre investimentos, produção e dinâmicas de mercado. Inicialmente, o setor beneficiou-se de contextos externos favoráveis, como a demanda por algodão local e políticas pós-abolição que ampliaram a disponibilidade de mão de obra. Contudo, a partir de determinado período, enfrentou desafios crescentes devido à concorrência de regiões mais industrializadas, que adotaram economias de escala e modernização acelerada. A gestão familiar, embora garantisse continuidade, limitou a inovação e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado. A estrutura oligopolista, marcada por poucas empresas dominantes, reduziu a competitividade e inibiu a entrada de novos agentes, conforme indicado por indicadores de concentração. A pesquisa revela que a baixa eficiência operacional, aliada à dificuldade de ampliar a capacidade produtiva, tornou o setor vulnerável a crises. Conclui-se que políticas industriais devem priorizar especificidades locais, incentivar a modernização e fortalecer redes produtivas, evitando ciclos de estagnação. A experiência maranhense destaca a necessidade de equilibrar concentração de mercado com dinamismo econômico para promover desenvolvimento sustentável em regiões periféricas.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究了1880年至1940年间马拉尼昂州纺织工业的发展历程，探讨了该产业的起步、扩张与衰退阶段。基于保罗·西洛斯·拉比尼（Paolo Sylos Labini）和琼·罗宾逊（Joan Robinson）的市场结构理论，研究分析了寡头垄断格局、家族式管理模式以及技术落后如何影响该地区的竞争力。研究方法结合了历史分析与微观经济学方法，使用了有关投资、生产和市场动态的数据。起初，该产业受益于有利的外部环境：当地对棉花的需求以及废奴后的政策扩大了劳动力供应。然而，随着某些时期更工业化地区的竞争加剧（这些地区采用了规模经济并加快了现代化进程），马拉尼昂州的纺织业面临日益严峻的挑战。尽管家族式管理模式确保了产业的延续性，但限制了创新和市场适应能力。寡头垄断格局（少数企业占据主导地位）降低了行业竞争力，并阻碍了新企业的进入（这一点通过市场集中度指标得到证实）。研究指出，低运营效率加上难以扩大生产能力，使得该产业容易受到经济危机的冲击。研究结论认为，产业政策应充分考虑地方特色，鼓励现代化进程并加强产业网络建设，以避免经济停滞的循环。马拉尼昂州的经验表明，在边缘地区实现可持续发展，需要平衡市场...。

papers.title: Multilevel Detection of Symbolic Violence Against Women in Reddit's Tech Communities Using BERT
papers.venue: International Journal of Combinatorial Optimization Problems and Informatics.
papers.abstract:
This paper presents an automated system for detecting and analyzing symbolic violence directed against women in Reddit’s tech communities. Unlike explicit aggression, symbolic violence manifests itself through practices such as the dismissal of professional competence, gender stereotypes, or the normalization of hostile work environments. The system employs a four-layer architecture: (1) a lexical rule classifier serving as a baseline; (2) a fine-tuned BERT model to distinguish between direct violence, subtle violence, and neutral content; (3) a post-processing module that corrects false positives; and (4) a context classifier that differentiates between violence actively perpetrated in the text (conversational) and accounts of lived experiences (testimonial). A total of 184,572 texts from 17 Reddit communities were analyzed during the 2016–2026 period. The BERT model achieved an accuracy of 84.90% with a macro-F1 score of 0.85, detecting 23.3% of violence compared to a 9.4% obtained by the rule-based classifier. The results show that 22.3% of the corpus contains some form of symbolic violence and that 99.9% of these texts correspond to testimonial discourse, indicating that these communities function as spaces for reporting and support, not aggression. The temporal analysis reveals a statistically significant downward trend (r²=0.58, p=0.0067), with a reduction of approximately 0.36 percentage points per year. However, the prevalence remains above 20% for most of the period, suggesting that, despite the progress made by social movements such as #MeToo or the Google Walkout, symbolic violence remains a structural problem in the sector. Subtle violence predominates in technical communities, while direct violence prevails in support communities.
 
Spanish-language metadata / Metadatos en españolTítulo en español:Detección multinivel de violencia simbólica contra las mujeres en comunidades tecnológicas de Reddit mediante BERT
Resumen:Este artículo presenta un sistema automatizado para detectar y analizar la violencia simbólica dirigida contra las mujeres en comunidades tecnológicas de Reddit. A diferencia de la agresión explícita, la violencia simbólica se manifiesta mediante prácticas como la desestimación de la competencia profesional, los estereotipos de género o la normalización de entornos laborales hostiles.
El sistema emplea una arquitectura de cuatro capas: (1) un clasificador basado en reglas léxicas que sirve como línea base; (2) un modelo BERT ajustado para distinguir entre violencia directa, violencia sutil y contenido neutral; (3) un módulo de posprocesamiento que corrige falsos positivos; y (4) un clasificador contextual que diferencia entre la violencia perpetrada activamente en el texto (conversacional) y los relatos de experiencias vividas (testimonial).
Se analizaron un total de 184.572 textos procedentes de 17 comunidades de Reddit durante el periodo 2016–2026. El modelo BERT alcanzó una exactitud del 84.90 %, con una puntuación macro-F1 de 0.85, y detectó un 23.3 % de violencia, frente al 9.4 % obtenido por el clasificador basado en reglas.
Los resultados muestran que el 22.3 % del corpus contiene alguna forma de violencia simbólica y que el 99.9 % de estos textos corresponde a discurso testimonial, lo que indica que estas comunidades funcionan como espacios de denuncia y apoyo, y no de agresión.
El análisis temporal revela una tendencia descendente estadísticamente significativa (r² = 0.58, p = 0.0067), con una reducción aproximada de 0.36 puntos porcentuales por año. Sin embargo, la prevalencia se mantiene por encima del 20 % durante la mayor parte del periodo, lo que sugiere que, a pesar de los avances asociados a movimientos sociales como #MeToo o Google Walkout, la violencia simbólica continúa siendo un problema estructural en el sector.
La violencia sutil predomina en las comunidades técnicas, mientras que la violencia directa prevalece en las comunidades de apoyo.
Palabras Claves:entornos laborales hostiles, mujeres en tecnología, violencia sexista, PLN

papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文提出了一种自动化系统，用于检测和分析Reddit技术社区中针对女性的象征性暴力行为。与明显的攻击行为不同，象征性暴力通过诸如贬低专业能力、性别刻板印象或使恶劣工作环境常态化等手段表现出来。该系统采用四层架构：（1）基于词汇规则的分类器作为基础；（2）经过微调的BERT模型，用于区分直接暴力、隐性暴力和中性内容；（3）后处理模块，用于纠正误报；（4）上下文分类器，用于区分文本中主动实施的暴力行为（对话形式）和关于个人经历的描述（证词形式）。在2016年至2026年期间，共分析了来自17个Reddit社区的184,572篇文本。BERT模型的准确率为84.90%，宏观F1分数为0.85，检测出的暴力行为占比为23.3%，而基于规则的分类器的准确率仅为9.4%。研究结果表明，22.3%的文本包含某种形式的象征性暴力，其中99.9%属于证词类内容，说明这些社区主要起到报告和支持的作用，而非攻击性场所。时间分析显示暴力行为呈显著下降趋势（r²=0.58，p=0.0067），每年减少约0.36个百分点。然而，在大部分研究期间，象征性暴力的发生率仍超过20%，这表明尽管有#MeToo或Go...。

papers.title: Does p-Hacking Mitigate or Exacerbate the Effects of Publication Bias?
papers.abstract: This paper studies the effects of p-hacking on the bias of published estimates when papers with statistically significant results are selectively published. We show that fast p-hacking---actions that lead to large changes in p-values---always exacerbates the bias from selective publication. On the other hand, slow p-hacking---actions that lead to small changes in p-values---exacerbates bias when selection is weak, but mitigates it when selection is strong. In a model featuring both types of p-hacking, we show that a normality assumption identifies the true distribution of effects as well as the counterfactual mean that would obtain under selective publication without p-hacking. Applying the model to meta-analyses on the effects of behavioral nudges and development aid, we find suggestive evidence that both mitigation and exacerbation can arise in practice.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】本文研究了当仅有统计显著结果的论文被选择性发表时，p值操纵（p-hacking）对已发表估计结果偏差的影响。我们发现，快速p值操纵（即导致p值发生较大变化的操作）会加剧选择性发表所带来的偏差；而缓慢p值操纵（即导致p值发生较小变化的操作）在选择性发表机制较弱时也会加剧偏差，但在机制较强时则能减轻偏差。在一个同时包含这两种p值操纵类型的模型中，我们发现正态性假设不仅有助于识别效应的真实分布，还能揭示在没有p值操纵的情况下选择性发表所导致的“反事实均值”。将该模型应用于关于行为干预和发展援助效果的元分析中，我们发现实践中确实存在偏差减轻和加剧的两种情况。。

papers.title: Optimal Rates for Agentic Networked Information Aggregation
papers.abstract: Building on the pioneering paper of Kearns, Roth, and Ryu (SODA'26), we study information aggregation in a networked learning model. The model captures a central pattern in agentic AI: each agent sees only part of the data and passes on only its own conclusion. Their model considers a linear regression problem with the mean squared error (MSE) loss. Agents sit in a DAG and each sees only a subset of the features and its parents' predictions, fits a linear predictor, and passes only its prediction forward. The benchmark is the full-feature learner that sees all raw features. A path of depth $D$ is $M$-covered if every block of $M$ consecutive agents collectively sees all raw features. Kearns, Roth, and Ryu proved that the excess mean squared error of the last agent on such a path is $O(M/\sqrt D)$, and gave a cyclic instance with excess error $Ω(M/D)$ for $D<M^2$.   We close this gap: the correct rate is constant up to depth $M^2$, and $Θ(M^2/D)$ beyond it. We first give a sharper analysis of the cyclic instance and improve its lower bound to $Ω(\sqrt{M/D})$ for $D<M^2$. We then construct, for every depth $D\ge M^2$, an $M$-covered path of depth $D$ with excess error $Ω(M^2/D)$. The same instance gives the constant lower bound for all $D < M^2$. We also show that for any fixed distribution the excess error contracts geometrically along the path, ruling out any single instance that witnesses any polynomial lower bound at every depth.   Finally, we prove the same optimal rate for logistic classification in the logit-passing model of Bateni et al., which considers the binary cross-entropy (BCE) loss. The same improved upper bound of $O(M^2/D)$ holds, and we transfer all the regression lower bounds by showing that on those examples the logistic path follows the least-squares path up to rescaling.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在Kearns、Roth和Ryu（SODA'26）的开创性论文基础上，我们研究了网络化学习模型中的信息聚合问题。该模型揭示了智能体AI的一个核心特征：每个智能体仅能观察到部分数据，并仅传递自身的预测结果。他们的模型采用均方误差（MSE）作为损失函数，通过线性回归方法进行建模。智能体位于有向无环图（DAG）中，每个智能体仅能看到部分特征及其父节点的预测结果，然后拟合一个线性预测器，并将自身的预测结果传递下去。作为基准的是能够观察到所有原始特征的完整模型。如果一条深度为$D$的路径上，每$M$个连续的智能体共同观察到所有原始特征，则称该路径为“$M$-覆盖”路径。Kearns、Roth和Ryu证明了在这类路径上最后一个智能体的额外均方误差为$O(M/\sqrt{D})$，并提出了一个循环实例，其额外误差为$Ω(M/D)$（其中$D<M^2$）。我们填补了这一研究空白：在深度$M^2$之前，额外误差的增长率是一个常数；超过$M^2$后，额外误差的增长率为$Θ(M^2/D)$。首先，我们对循环实例进行了更细致的分析，并将其下界改进为$Ω(\sqrt{M/D})$（其中$D<M^2$）。接...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Air Pollution and Learning
papers.abstract: Nearly the entire world's population breathes air exceeding WHO pollution guidelines, but the extent to which that exposure impairs the accumulation of human capital is not well understood. We study this using longitudinal PSAT data on nearly 10 million U.S. high school students, comparing the same student's scores across attempts preceded by differing air quality and instrumenting for local PM2.5 with smoke from distant wildfires. A year of observed pollution exposure reduces learning by 0.04-0.06 standard deviations, or 14-19% of typical annual score growth. The damage comes almost entirely from moderate pollution days (8–12 μg/m3), below the EPA's historical standard, and from exposure during the school year rather than summer, pointing to instructional disruption as a mechanism. Effects are three times larger in disadvantaged schools and among Black and Hispanic students, who are harmed more by the same exposure. Exposure to air pollution widens achievement gaps.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】全球几乎所有人口所呼吸的空气都超过了世界卫生组织（WHO）规定的污染标准，但这种污染对人类资本积累的具体影响尚未得到充分了解。我们利用针对近1000万美国高中生的纵向PSAT数据进行了研究，比较了同一学生在不同空气质量条件下多次考试的成绩，并考虑了当地PM2.5污染与远处野火产生的烟雾之间的关联。一年内的污染暴露会导致学生的学习成绩下降0.04至0.06个标准差，相当于年均成绩增长量的14%至19%。这种负面影响主要来自中度污染天气（PM2.5浓度为8–12 μg/m³），这一浓度低于美国环保署（EPA）的历史标准；而且污染影响主要发生在学年期间，而非夏季，这表明教学活动的中断可能是造成成绩下降的机制。在条件较差的学校以及黑人学生和西班牙裔学生中，污染的影响更为显著，他们受到的危害更大。空气污染加剧了教育成就的差距。。

papers.title: Health Insurance Underwriting and the Heterogeneous Effects of the Affordable Care Act
papers.abstract: The Affordable Care Act, the largest US welfare reform since 1965, banned health insurance underwriting and rejections based on pre-existing conditions and introduced large premium subsidies for low- to middle-income individuals. Yet how many people the ban made better off, and how its effects varied by health risk, remain unknown—because data on who was rejected before the reform have been lacking. Using a proprietary dataset of pre-ACA insurance applications and underwriting decisions, we document, model, and estimate the reform's heterogeneous effects by age, income, and health risk. We find its benefits were concentrated among low-income, high-risk, or over-50 individuals.
papers.summary_zh: 【保险与养老】《平价医疗法案》是美国自1965年以来规模最大的福利改革举措，该法案禁止基于患者既往健康状况进行医疗保险的承保决策或拒绝投保行为，并为低收入至中等收入人群提供了大幅的保费补贴。然而，这项改革究竟使多少人受益，以及其影响在不同健康风险群体中的具体表现如何，目前仍不清楚——因为缺乏改革前关于被拒绝投保者的相关数据。通过使用一份包含《平价医疗法案》实施前医疗保险申请及承保决策的专有数据集，我们详细记录、建模并估算了该改革对不同年龄、收入及健康风险群体的影响。研究发现，改革带来的福利主要惠及了低收入人群、高风险患者以及50岁以上的老年人。。

papers.title: Quantity, Risk, and Return
papers.abstract: We propose a new model of expected stock returns that incorporates quantity information from market trading activities into the factor pricing framework. We posit that the expected return of a stock is determined by not only its factor risk exposures (beta) but also the factor's quantity fluctuations (q) induced by trading flows, and hence term the model beta times quantity (BTQ). The rationale is that sophisticated investors should demand a higher factor premium when they have absorbed noise trading flows of stocks with high loadings to that factor. The BTQ model provides a compelling risk-based explanation for stock returns, which is otherwise obscured without considering the quantity information. The cross-sectional risk-return association, which is nearly flat unconditionally, strongly depends on the quantity variable. The structured BTQ model reliably predicts monthly stock returns out of sample, and addresses the factor zoo problem by selecting a small number of factors.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】我们提出了一种新的预期股票回报模型，该模型将市场交易活动中的数量信息纳入因子定价框架中。我们认为，股票的预期回报不仅取决于其因子风险敞口（beta），还取决于交易流动所引起的因子数量波动（q），因此将此模型称为“beta乘以数量”（BTQ）模型。其理论依据是：当 sophisticated investors（此处可能需根据上下文明确“sophisticated investors”的具体含义，如“精明的投资者”等）吸收了与某一因子相关性较高的股票的噪声交易流动后，他们应该要求更高的因子溢价。BTQ 模型为股票回报提供了一个基于风险的合理解释；如果不考虑数量信息，这种解释将变得模糊不清。这种横截面上的风险-回报关联在无条件情况下几乎是平坦的，但实际上它强烈依赖于数量变量。该结构化的 BTQ 模型能够可靠地预测样本外的月度股票回报，并通过选择少量因子来解决“因子动物园问题”（即因子数量过多导致模型复杂度增加的问题）。。研究方法：横截面分析。

papers.title: Creators Have Difficulty Abandoning Ideas They Generated
papers.abstract: Creativity researchers often distinguish between two stages of the creative process: generation versus selection. While much is known about the psychology of idea generation (e.g., the factors that lead to a greater number of novel and useful ideas), less is understood about the nature of selection, or how generation and selection interact. Here we investigate how the act of generating ideas may potentially distort the selection process. Using an incentive-compatible paradigm in which pairs of participants reviewed the same ideas and were rewarded for submitting only high-quality ideas, we find that people submit a greater number of lower-quality ideas when selecting among their own ideas than when selecting among another person's ideas (the Creative Endowment Effect). This effect generalizes across three tasks in two domains and is resistant to an informational intervention (i.e., explicitly telling people about the effect). However, having participants revisit their ideas several months later increases their selectivity. The broader implications for individuals and organizations are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】创造力研究者通常将创造性过程分为两个阶段：创意生成（generation）与创意筛选（selection）。虽然关于创意生成的心理学机制已有较多研究（例如，哪些因素能够产生更多新颖且有用的想法），但对于创意筛选的本质以及生成与筛选之间的相互作用机制了解仍然有限。在本研究中，我们探讨了创意生成行为可能如何扭曲筛选过程。通过设计一种激励机制，让参与者成对审查相同的想法，并仅对高质量的想法给予奖励，我们发现：当参与者从自己的想法中挑选时，他们提交的低质量想法数量反而更多（这种现象被称为“创造性禀赋效应”）。这一效应在两个领域的三项任务中均得到了验证，并且不受信息干预的影响（即，即使明确告知参与者这一效应的存在，该现象依然存在）。然而，让参与者在几个月后重新审视自己的想法后，他们的筛选能力有所提高。本文还讨论了这一现象对个人和组织可能产生的更广泛影响。。

papers.title: Gatheral's Conjecture Revisited
papers.abstract: We compare the Heston model with $ρ=-1$ to the one-dimensional local-volatility model calibrated to the same European option prices. We show that, for each fixed expiry $T>0$, their integrated variances satisfy \[   I_T^{\mathrm H}\prec_{\mathrm{cx}} I_T^{\mathrm{LV}}. \] This strict ordering gives a Heston-model counterexample to the convex-order inequality conjectured by J.\ Gatheral
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在探讨 Gatheral 提出的凸序不等式猜想，具体比较了 Heston 模型与局部波动率模型在特定参数下的积分方差关系。

🔬 研究方法：研究方法是将 Heston 模型（相关系数 $\rho=-1$）与校准至相同欧洲期权价格的局部波动率模型进行对比分析。

📊 核心发现：研究发现对于固定的到期日 $T>0$，两者的积分方差满足严格的不等式关系 $I_T^{\mathrm H}\prec_{\mathrm{cx}} I_T^{\mathrm{LV}}$，从而为 Gatheral 的猜想提供了一个反例。

💡 应用价值：该发现挑战了原有的理论不等式，为波动率建模和金融衍生品

papers.title: Identification and Estimation of Intergenerational Income Mobility Measures
papers.abstract: Measuring the intergenerational transmission of lifetime economic status is complicated by researchers often only observing snapshots of income at specific ages. Consequently, standard practice estimates intergenerational mobility using income averages, introducing life-cycle bias that compromises reliability and comparability across studies, time, and place. I develop a missing data framework that exploits available income data and observable characteristics to eliminate life-cycle bias. This method combines nonparametric identification with Neyman-orthogonal moments to construct debiased machine learning estimators for intergenerational income mobility measures under plausible missing-at-random and testable independence assumptions. I apply this framework to estimate the intergenerational elasticity for the U.S. using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics across birth cohorts from 1954 to 1977 with rolling 10-year windows. While existing approaches estimate values between 0.41 and 0.54, the proposed method yields substantially higher estimates ranging from 0.6 to 0.7, averaging 0.64. These results align closely with recent evidence using long time averages over mid-career periods, reinforcing high U.S. intergenerational persistence.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】衡量代际间经济地位的传递情况颇具复杂性，因为研究人员通常只能观察到特定年龄阶段的收入数据。因此，传统的估算方法采用收入平均值来评估代际流动性，但这会引入生命周期偏差，从而影响研究结果在不同时间、地区及群体间的可靠性和可比性。我提出了一种基于缺失数据处理的框架，该框架利用现有的收入数据及可观测的特征来消除生命周期偏差。该方法结合了非参数识别技术与Neyman-正交矩理论，能够在合理的随机缺失假设及可检验的独立性条件下，构建出无偏的机器学习估计量，用于评估代际收入流动性。我运用这一框架，以1954至1977年间各出生队列的“收入动态追踪调查”数据（采用滚动10年的时间窗口）来估算美国的代际弹性系数。虽然现有方法的估算结果介于0.41至0.54之间，但所提出的方法得出的估计值显著更高，范围为0.6至0.7，平均值为0.64。这些结果与近期基于职业生涯中期数据长期平均值的研究结果高度一致，进一步证实了美国代际经济地位传递的显著持续性。。研究方法：机器学习。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Equity and Crypto Markets: Progress, Profitability Evidence, and the Limits of Automated Investing
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) now supports investment workflows from data and prediction through research, portfolios, execution, and tool use. Technical capability, however, is not evidence of investment profitability. This critical state-of-the-art review examines public research available through 31 August 2026 on listed equities, exchange-traded funds, centralized crypto spot, perpetual futures, and on-chain markets. We organize evidence with an alpha-translation chain: point-in-time information must yield a stable signal, feasible positions, executable orders, and risk-adjusted returns after costs. Across machine learning, time-series foundation models, financial language models, reinforcement learning, and agents, the examined record shows real but mainly upstream progress in prediction, text processing, portfolio design, and workflow integration. Evidence is thinner for durable net performance. Temporal contamination, repeated selection, survivorship, weak benchmarks, implementation costs, venue mechanics, and capacity can break translation to net alpha. Strong historical results coexist with predictor decay, corrected look-ahead failures, mixed prospective evidence, and few audited live-capital records. Crypto adds informative state but requires separate treatment of spot, perpetual, and decentralized cash flows and execution. Within the public evidence examined here, no general AI architecture is shown to deliver persistent, cross-regime, capacity-aware net alpha. More credible claims require point-in-time data and models, decision-aligned objectives, joint portfolio--execution evaluation, controlled adaptation, prospective tests, and authority-matched governance. These conditions can improve evidence and implementation; they do not guarantee profit.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智能（AI）现已支持从数据收集与预测到研究分析、投资组合构建、交易执行以及工具应用等整个投资工作流程。然而，技术能力本身并不能直接证明投资活动的盈利能力。这篇重要的前沿综述分析了截至2026年8月31日公开的关于上市股票、交易所交易基金（ETFs）、中心化加密货币现货市场、永续期货以及区块链市场的研究文献。我们通过一套逻辑框架来整理这些研究结果：任何基于实时数据的研究成果都必须能够产生稳定的信号、可行的投资策略、可执行的交易指令，并在扣除成本后实现经风险调整的回报。在机器学习、时间序列基础模型、金融语言模型、强化学习以及智能代理等领域，研究进展主要体现在预测能力、文本处理能力、投资组合设计以及工作流程整合方面；但在实现长期、可持续的净投资回报方面，相关证据仍较为有限。影响研究结果的因素包括数据的时间相关性、样本选择偏差、数据选择性偏差、基准指标的可靠性不足、实施成本、交易平台的具体规则以及系统的处理能力等。尽管某些AI模型在历史数据上表现优异，但它们也存在预测能力下降、预测结果存在偏差等问题；同时，也有部分研究结果缺乏严谨的验证，且实际投资表现记录较少。对于加密货币领域，虽然...。研究方法：机器学习。

papers.title: Pensions and Turbulence: Automatic Adjustment, Risk, and Fairness in Long-Term Pension Design
papers.abstract: Public pension systems are long-term social contracts operating under persistent economic, demographic, and political uncertainty. Periods of turbulence, marked by financial shocks, changes in longevity, and shifting labour markets, test the capacity of pension institutions to adapt while maintaining adequacy, equity, and legitimacy. Building on earlier joint work on pension economics and reform with Nicholas Barr, this chapter analyses the role of automatic and semi-automatic adjustment mechanisms in public pension design. Drawing on comparative experience from Sweden, Canada, and the United States, we examine mechanisms for maintaining financial balance, the incorporation of life expectancy into retirement age and benefit design, and the accumulation and drawdown phases of defined contribution pensions. We argue that well-designed automatic mechanisms can discipline political decision-making and improve resilience, but only if they are proportionate, transparent, and attentive to distributional and intergenerational consequences. In turbulent times, good pension design does not eliminate the need for political choice; rather, it structures that choice so that adjustment can occur without repeated crises.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】公共养老金制度是一种长期的社会契约，其运作面临着持续的经济、人口和政治不确定性。在金融冲击、寿命变化以及劳动力市场波动等动荡时期，这些因素考验着养老金机构在保持充足性、公平性和合法性的同时进行适应的能力。在之前与Nicholas Barr共同研究的养老金经济学与改革基础上，本章探讨了自动调节机制和半自动调节机制在公共养老金设计中的作用。通过借鉴瑞典、加拿大和美国的经验，我们分析了维护财务平衡的机制、将预期寿命纳入退休年龄和福利设计的做法，以及固定缴费型养老金的积累和领取阶段。我们认为，设计合理的自动调节机制能够规范政治决策过程并提升系统的韧性，但前提是这些机制必须具有合理性、透明度，并充分考虑分配效应和代际影响。在动荡时期，良好的养老金设计并不能完全消除政治决策的必要性；相反，它通过合理的设计框架，使调整过程能够在不引发反复危机的情况下顺利进行。。
